children: China precious metals retailer's interim revenue rose sharply year-over-year
Net income attributable to owners decreased slightly from prior year period
Growth driven by higher silver product sales and new colored gemstone segment
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for future periods
SILVER PRODUCT SALES - Co said revenue from silver products rose sharply, up 252.4% year-over-year to RMB320.2 mln in 1H2026
COLORED GEMSTONE SEGMENT - Co said colored gemstone sales contributed RMB473.5 mln in 1H2026, with no corresponding sales in 1H2025
LOWER-MARGIN PRODUCT MIX – Gross margin fell to 15.4% from 42.2% as colored gemstones, which carry lower margins than gold and silver products, became the largest revenue source
